text:
Sam K.: Morning team, starting Vectora POC discussion. Customer goal: evaluate Vectora-13B open variant for chat + document summarization in their product. Two asks up front: (1) compatibility checklist (tokenizer, kv-cache, quant options), (2) clear POC pricing + path to Dedicated if they scale. Target SLO ~200ms p95 for short prompts, can spike for long sessions. Who can lead technical presales?

Elaine C.: I can take catalog/compat. Need sample prompt distribution (avg/max tokens), whether streaming & function calling required in POC, and if KMS/SOC2 required. Also confirm whether they need eval harness for hallucination checks.

Sam K.: Distribution: 60% <=64 tokens, 30% 65-512, 10% 512-2048. They expect streaming and function calls eventually. SOC2 yes; KMS likely. Eval harness would be helpful.

Miguel R.: Noted. Quick heads-up: Vectora uses SentencePiece with custom control tokens. If their tokenizer diverges from our catalog we can provide a tokenizer adapter or request they pre-tokenize. KV cache layout is standard, but rotary dims vary (mixed 64/128) which affects kernel selection. I'll run a local model-scan.

InfraBot: model-scan result (job=vscan-9927) -> tokenizer: sentencepiece + 3 custom tokens detected -> recommend adapter; kernels: mixed rotary dims -> runtime kernel tuning recommended; quant candidates: q4_0, q8_0 (q4_0 shows promising fp16 sim); kv-cache: standard; licensing: open, no blocker; Private deploy: KMS support required.

Priya S.: AE asks for hosted vs reserved POC pricing for ~10M tokens over 30 days with streaming. Also want an option for a 30-day discounted Dedicated trial if they commit. Can we get a back-of-envelope?

Elaine C.: Ballpark hosted cost for 10M tokens on vectora-13b (q4_0): ~$1.2k generation + infra overhead. Dedicated 8xA10s list ~$35k/mo; offer typical POC discount 50-70% for first month + onboarding credits. I'll confirm with pricing ops.

Miguel R.: Dev tasks to unblock: tokenizer adapter (~1-2 dev-days), runtime kernel patch for mixed rotary dims (~2 dev-days + QA), create/validate q4_0 quant variant (~1 dev-day + validation). I'll open infra ticket and estimate more precisely.

Miguel R.: Suggested canary rollout config (example): { rollout: canary, traffic_split: {"vectora-13b-q4_0": 10, "vectora-13b-fp16": 90}, monitoring: ["latency_p95","error_rate","quality_regressions"], fallback: "vectora-13b-fp16" }

Sam K.: Nice. Elaine -> verify pricing + security (SOC2 + KMS) artifacts and confirm discount range. Miguel -> infra ticket + quant artifact. Priya -> draft POC SOW options. I'll send their security checklist and ask for sample prompts/dataset.

Elaine C.: I'll run quality regression on a 500-sample prompt set; please upload to redwood://sales/vectora/poc/samples. Also pinging Security for KMS onboarding steps: https://redwood.ai/security/questionnaire.

LegalBot: Flag for legal: ensure KMS language added for Private deployments; validate SOC2 cross-check. I'll open LGTM-Legal task.

Miguel R.: INF-4819 created: runtime kernel + tokenizer adapter + quant variant. ETA initial patch 3 business days, QA + canary 2 days. Assign eng-runtime & infra.

Priya S.: Drafting POC SOW: three pricing paths - (A) Hosted pay-as-you-go, (B) 30-day reserved trial (discounted), (C) Dedicated onboarding (commit + monthly infra). Will include acceptance criteria: latency p95, token budget, streaming/function-call support, and security artifacts.

Sam K.: Quick customer checklist I'll send: 1) 500 example prompts (upload link), 2) SOC2 cert + KMS contact, 3) target latency/throughput, 4) a small validation dataset for quality checks.

Elaine C.: Also note: if customer needs function-calling in POC, we should run a separate test harness for structured outputs. Add to checklist.

Priya S.: I'll include contract path note in the SOW and loop account team if they convert to Dedicated after POC.

Sam K.: Action items recap: Elaine -> compatibility + pricing confirmation + quality runs (1 business day). Miguel -> infra ticket and quant variant work (INF-4819). Priya -> POC SOW + AE comms. LegalBot -> KMS & SOC2 language. Sam -> customer checklist & outreach.

Elaine C.: One more ask: can the customer provide a short latency-critical prompt subset (50 samples) to use for p95 testing?

Sam K.: I'll request that. Thanks all :rocket:
